sentence_stem: Only after the sun had set,
correct_completion: did the travellers finally reach the village.
full_sentence: Only after the sun had set, did the travellers finally reach the village.
acceptable_variants: did the caravan at last arrive in the village.
did the travellers eventually reach the settlement.

options.text: the travellers reached the village by dawn.
options.why_wrong: This affirmative word order ignores the inversion that a fronted 'Only after' phrase requires.

options.text: so the travellers reached the village quickly.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result and does not complete the inverted structure begun by 'Only after'.
'Because' gives a cause, but the stem needs a main clause with subject-auxiliary inversion.

options.text: did the travellers finally reach the village.

grammar_focus: Subject-auxiliary inversion after 'only after' fronted adverbials
explanation: A fronted 'Only after' phrase requires the auxiliary to precede the subject in the main clause ('did the travellers').
translation: Лише після заходу сонця мандрівники нарешті дісталися села.
